text: Apiculture is keeping honey bees in hives. Five species matter in Nepal. Apis cerana, the mauri, nests in dark cavities, so it can be coaxed into a box; it makes up about three quarters of Nepal's hives and survives up to three and a half thousand metres. Apis mellifera, the European bee, came in nineteen ninety two. The rock bee, the cliff bee and the little bee build single open combs and cannot be hived.
